Projects: 1. AI Powered Speech Analysis Tool for Speech Therapists Elswin developed a Django-based web application to assist therapists in diagnosing speech disorders such as dysarthria. Integrated real-time audio capture and MFCC feature extraction using Librosa, enabling seamless voice input analysis.

Projects: Engineered a Machine Learning (Random Forest) model with 98% accuracy and utilized Scikit-learn for robust classification. Designed clear visualizations of audio features with Matplotlib and deployed a responsive, secure clinical interface tailored for therapist usability. Presented at ICIMRBE, April 4, 2025.

Projects: 2. Vendor-IQ, Vendor ESG Screening Platform 07/26 – 07/26 VendorlQ is a Vendor ESG Assessment platform that enables organizations to evaluate, monitor, and manage the sustainability performance of their vendors.

Projects: The platform provides a structured ESG questionnaire covering Environmental, Social, and Governance aspects, calculates ESG scores, assigns vendor risk classifications, and provides scorecards, improvement areas, and performance roadmaps.

Projects: It also supports monthly assessments, monthly reports, annualized ESG reports, PDF generation, and historical performance tracking, helping organizations make informed decisions about vendor sustainability and ESG risk.

Projects: 3. AI-Driven Smart Agriculture with Soil Intelligence and Explainable AI Elswin developed an AI-powered and Machine Learning smart agriculture system using IoT sensors (ESP32) to collect real-time soil data and provide crop and fertilizer recommendations.
Projects: Integrated SHAP and LIME for explainable predictions and built a full-stack solution with FastAPI and React/Streamlit, including a chatbot interface for user interaction.

Projects: 4. EnSoGo – Sustainability Readiness Intelligence Chatbot -Integrated Elswin developed a web application that scores organizations on sustainability and certification readiness using the SAM BRD v2.0 framework.

Projects: Built the backend with Node.js and Express for Scope 1/2/3 emissions and scoring, the frontend with React + Vite + Tailwind featuring Recharts dashboards, and used MongoDB with Mongoose for data storage. Implemented JWT authentication. Tech: React, Vite, Tailwind, Node.js, Express, MongoDB, JWT.
